WITH SRC AS
(
SELECT DISTINCT 
	ISNULL(ID,'') AS ID
	,ISNULL(Attribute_MIDDLE_NAME,'') AS Attribute_MIDDLE_NAME
	,ISNULL(Full_Name,'') AS Full_Name
	,ISNULL(Short_Name,'') AS Short_Name
	,ISNULL(External_Ref,'') AS External_Ref
	,ISNULL(Roles,'') AS Roles
	,ISNULL(Status,'') AS Status
	,ISNULL(BNK_CODE,'') AS BNK_CODE
	,ISNULL(SOURCE_CODE,'') AS SOURCE_CODE
	,ISNULL(FILE_NAME,'') AS FILE_NAME
	,ISNULL(insert_dttm,'') AS insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.TRY_LEGALENTITY
),
TGT AS
(
SELECT DISTINCT
	ISNULL(ID,'') AS ID
	,ISNULL([Attribute.MIDDLE_NAME],'') AS Attribute_MIDDLE_NAME
	,ISNULL(Full_Name,'') AS Full_Name
	,ISNULL(Short_Name,'') AS Short_Name
	,ISNULL(External_Ref,'') AS External_Ref
	,ISNULL(Roles,'') AS Roles
	,ISNULL(Status,'') AS Status
	,ISNULL(BANK_CODE,'') AS BANK_CODE
	,ISNULL(SOURCE_CODE,'') AS SOURCE_CODE
	,ISNULL(FILE_NAME,'') AS FILE_NAME
	,ISNULL(insert_dttm,'') AS insert_dttm
FROM SYN.STG_TRY_LEGALENTITY
)

SELECT count(1)
FROM SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TGT
	ON SRC.[ID] =  TGT.[ID]
	AND SRC.[Attribute_MIDDLE_NAME] =  TGT.[Attribute_MIDDLE_NAME]
	AND SRC.[Full_Name] =  TGT.[Full_Name]
	AND SRC.[Short_Name] =  TGT.[Short_Name]
	AND SRC.[External_Ref] =  TGT.[External_Ref]
	AND SRC.[Roles] =  TGT.[Roles]
	AND SRC.[Status] =  TGT.[Status]
	AND SRC.[BNK_CODE] =  TGT.[BANK_CODE]
	AND SRC.[SOURCE_CODE] =  TGT.[SOURCE_CODE]
	AND SRC.[FILE_NAME] =  TGT.[FILE_NAME]
	AND SRC.[insert_dttm] =  TGT.[insert_dttm]


WHERE (
	SRC.[ID] IS NULL OR TGT.[ID] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[Attribute_MIDDLE_NAME] IS NULL OR TGT.[Attribute_MIDDLE_NAME] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[Full_Name] IS NULL OR TGT.[Full_Name] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[Short_Name] IS NULL OR TGT.[Short_Name] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[External_Ref] IS NULL OR TGT.[External_Ref] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[Roles] IS NULL OR TGT.[Roles] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[Status] IS NULL OR TGT.[Status] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[BNK_CODE] IS NULL OR TGT.[BANK_CODE] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[SOURCE_CODE] IS NULL OR TGT.[SOURCE_CODE] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[FILE_NAME] IS NULL OR TGT.[FILE_NAME] IS NULL
	OR SRC.[insert_dttm] IS NULL OR TGT.[insert_dttm] IS NULL

)
